findings.title: The set-to-sorted-set change breaks existing live buffer keys
findings.body: Before this deployment, span payloads are stored in Redis sets; this code now calls `ZADD` on the same key names, and the Lua script also uses sorted-set commands on those keys. Existing keys will remain sets until their TTL expires, so during a rollout any new span that touches one will fail with Redis `WRONGTYPE` and its batch will not be processed. Use versioned keys or provide a migration/compatibility path before switching the data type.

findings.title: Optimized pagination fails for datetime sort keys
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint passes `order_by="-datetime"` to this paginator, but `get_item_key` applies `math.floor` to the datetime field. `math.floor(datetime)` raises `TypeError`, so an authorized request with `optimized_pagination=true` fails when cursor construction evaluates the returned rows. Handle datetime values as `DateTimePaginator` does, or use that paginator's datetime conversion logic.

findings.title: Negative cursor offsets produce unsupported queryset slices
findings.body: This branch passes a negative start offset into a Django `QuerySet` slice. Django does not support negative indexing or slicing and raises `AssertionError`, so a request using an optimized cursor with a negative offset returns an error instead of a page. Clamp or translate the offset into a supported query before slicing.
